recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-6945; future concerns about reasons for referenced CarePlan activities should be addressed on the referenced request resource or by a new Patient Care decision.
issue_request: FHIR-6945 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care DSTU1 request to change CarePlan.Activity.detail.reasonReference from 0..1 to 0..* so one activity can cite multiple reason references.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN #6766. The corresponding git-svn commit d6c4981fa8fe7d58cc3e1cc393aa8cc0b6a83c54 updated the CarePlan spreadsheet with CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonReference cardinality 0..*. The later R4B StructureDefinition XML import in c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 preserved the active element with max="*".
additional_context: CarePlan remains active in source/fhir.ini, but source/fhir.ini maps old CarePlan.activity.detail to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference. The current source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml has no active CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonReference; the legacy plannedActivityDetail subtree is commented out. Later Patient Care decisions FHIR-26064 and FHIR-39101 refactored and then removed plannedActivityDetail, while FHIR-28546 confirms that in R5 the inline detail reasonReference is no longer applicable and reasons should live on referenced request resources.
reconciliation: No source change was made. There is no active stale 0..1 CarePlan activity reasonReference in the current build, and the absence of the old active element is explained by later published refactoring decisions rather than a missed application of FHIR-6945.

related_jiras.note: Renamed CarePlan.activity.reference/detail to plannedActivityReference/plannedActivityDetail and introduced performedActivity, establishing the later activity-model refactor context.
Removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail from the active model and shifted inline representation to contained or referenced request resources.
Resolved No Change decision states that CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonReference is no longer applicable in R5 and reasons belong on referenced request resources.
